questions.question: Arrange the functions (3)/(4),(5)/({12)},frac{{13}}{{16}},frac{{16}}{{29}},(3)/(8) in their ascending order of magnitude.
Calculate the value of frac{{sqrt 3 }}{{( {3 + sqrt 3 } )}}, if √3 = 1.7320.
Determine the value of ‘a’ which satisfies the equation: {9sqrt a } + {40sqrt a } = {41sqrt a }.
questions.solution:
Let x = √a

Hence, we can write,

⇒ 9x + 40x = 41x

Putting x = 1,

⇒ 9¹ + 40¹ = 9 + 40 = 49 ≠ 41¹

Putting x = 2,

⇒ 9² + 40² = 81 + 1600 = 1681 = 41²

⇒ x = √a = 2

⇒ a= 2²

∴ a = 4

questions.question: 5 bottles cost as much as 2 bags. The cost of 15 bottles and 4 bags is Rs. 2,000. What is the price (in Rs.) of a single bag?
questions.solution:
Let the price of a single bag be Rs. ‘x’

Cost of 5 bottles = Cost of 2 bags = 2x

Now,

Cost of 15 bottles + Cost of 4 bags = 2000

⇒ 3(2x) + 4x = 2000

⇒ 6x + 4x = 2000

⇒ 10x = 2000

⇒ x = 2000/10 = Rs. 200

∴ Price of one bag = Rs. 200

questions.question: If any two sides of a triangle are divided by the line in the same ratio, then the line must be ________ to the third side of the triangle.
questions.solution:
According to the basic proportionality theorem, if a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle so as to intersect the other two sides, then it divides the other two sides in the same ratio

∴ If any two sides of a triangle are divided by the line in the same ratio, then the line must be parallel to the third side of the triangle

questions.question: If the radius of a circumscribed circle in an equilateral triangle is 14 cm. Then what will be the radius (in cm) of the inscribed circle?
questions.solution:
**Detailed solution:- **

Let a be the side of the equilateral triangle ABC.

∴ AB = BC = AC = a 

and since Δ ABC is an equilateral triangle ∠A=∠B=∠C=60 

Given, the radius of the circumcircle, r = 14 cm 

Since the triangle ABC is equilateral, its perpendicular bisector i.e. the median meet at the same point O which is the center of the in-circle

 ∴ AD is the perpendicular bisector of BC.

⇒ BD = DC = 1/2BC

and OB is the angle bisector of.∠B 

∴ ∠ABO =∠ OBD = 60/2 = 30 

In right angle Δ ODB 

⇒ sin30 = OD/OB 

⇒ OD/r = 1/2 

⇒ OD = r/2 = 14/2 =7 

**∴ The required answer is 7. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

If the radius of a circumscribed circle is R units, then the radius of the inscribed circle is equal to R/2 units

∴ Radius of inscribed circle = 14/2 = 7 c

questions.question: If 35% of (x + y) = 40% of (x - y), then x is what percentage of y?
The ratio of two numbers is 6 : 11 and their difference is 65. What will be the smaller number among both the numbers?
questions.solution:
Let the two numbers be ‘6x’ and ‘11x’ respectively

Difference = 11x – 6x = 65

⇒ 5x = 65

⇒ x = 65/5 = 13

∴ Smaller number = 6x = 6(13) = 78

questions.question: In a mixture of milk and water, there is 19% milk. If the quantity of milk in the mixture is 437 millilitres, then what is the total quantity (in millilitres) of the mixture?
questions.solution:
The quantity of milk in the mixture = 19% of the total quantity of the mixture

⇒ 437 = 19/100 × (Total quantity of the mixture)

∴ Total quantity of the mixture = 437 × 100/19 = 2300 millilitres

questions.question: If in the population of a town there is an increase of 44% in the first year and 75% in the second year, then what is the average rate of increase in the population?
questions.solution:
Let the initial population be ‘x’

Population after first year = (100 + 44)% of x = 1.44x

Population after second year = (100 + 75)% of 1.44x = 1.75 × 1.44x = 2.52x

⇒ Total increase in population = 2.52x – x = 1.52x

⇒ Rate of increase in population = 1.52x/x × 100 = 152%

∴ Average rate of increase in population = 152/2 = 76%

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 2000 becomes Rs. 3645 in 2 years at a certain rate of compound interest. What will be the sum (in Rs.) after 4 years?
questions.solution:
When the interest is compounded annually,

Amount after n years = Principal × (1 + Rate/100)ⁿ

Given, Principal = Rs. 2000

Amount after 2 years = Rs. 3645

⇒ 3645 = 2000 × (1 + Rate/100)²

⇒ (1 + Rate/100)² = 3645/2000 = 729/400

Now,

Amount after 4 years = 2000 × (1 + Rate/100)⁴ = 2000 × (1 + Rate/100)² × (1 + Rate/100)²

∴ Amount after 4 years = 3645 × 729/400 = Rs. 6643.0125

questions.question: Mohit sells a table at a profit of 25%. If he reduces its selling price by Rs. 240, then he suffers a loss of 5%. What was the initial selling price (in Rs.) of the table?
questions.solution:
Let the initial selling price of the table be Rs. ‘x’

Profit earned = 25% of CP

⇒ CP + 0.25CP = x

⇒ CP = x/1.25 =0.8x

Now, if he reduces selling price by Rs. 240, he suffers a loss of 5%

⇒ Selling price = Cost price – Loss

⇒ x – 240 = 0.8x – 5% of 0.8x

⇒ x – 240 = 0.8x – 0.04x

⇒ x – 240 = 0.76x

⇒ x – 0.76x = 240

⇒ 0.24x = 240

⇒ x = 240/0.24 = Rs. 1000

∴ Initial selling price of table is Rs. 1000

questions.question: If two successive discounts of 25% and 30% are given, then what will be the ratio of marked price to selling price?
questions.solution:
Let the marked price be Rs. ‘x’

Price after first discount = (100 – 25)% of x = 75% of x = (3/4)x

Price after second discount = (100 – 30)% of (3/4)x = 70% of (3/4)x = 7/10 × (3/4)x = (21/40)x

⇒ Selling price = (21/40)x

∴ Ratio of marked price to selling price = x ∶ (21/40)x = 40 ∶ 21

questions.question: If 49 is subtracted from the square of a number, then the result obtained is 576. What is the number?
questions.solution:
Let the number be ‘x’

Hence, we can write,

⇒ x² – 49 = 576

⇒ x² = 576 + 49

⇒ x² = 625

⇒ x = √625 = 25

∴ The number is 25

questions.question: P, Q and R together can make a table in 40 minutes. P and Q together can make it in 60 minutes. How much time (in minutes) will R alone take to make the table?
questions.solution:
Work done by P, Q, and R in 1 min. = 1/40

Work done by P, Q in 1 min. = 1/60

⇒ Work done by R in 1 min. = 1/40 – 1/60 = 1/120

∴ R will alone make the table in 120 minutes

questions.question: Two trains are running in opposite directions with the same speed. If the length of each train is 486 metres and they cross each other in 27 seconds, then what is the speed (in km/hr) of each train?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the speed of each train be ‘x’ m/s

∵ The trains are running in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds

⇒ Relative speed = 2x m/s

Now,

Time taken to cross = Sum of lengths of train/Relative speed

 ⇒ 27 = (486 + 486)/2x

⇒ 2x = 972/27

⇒ 2x = 36

⇒ x = 18 m/s

Thus, Speed of each train = x

⇒ 18 m/s

⇒ 18 × 18/5 km/h

⇒ 64.8 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

questions.question: Admissions in 2016 were greater than that in 2015 by _______.
questions.solution:

Difference = 9500 – 4000 = 5500

Required percentage = 5500/4000 × 100 = 137.5%

questions.question: The perimeter and the breadth of a rectangle are 44 cm and 10 cm respectively. Find its area (in cm²).
questions.solution:
Perimeter of rectangle = 2(Length + Breadth)

⇒ 44 = 2(Length + 10)

⇒ 22 = Length + 10

⇒ Length of rectangle = 22 – 10 = 12 cm

∴ Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth = 12 × 10 = 120 cm²

questions.question: What is the measure (in degree) of an exterior angle of a regular polygon of 9 sides?
questions.solution:
For a regular polygon of ‘n’ sides, measure of exterior angle = 360°/n

∴ Measure of exterior angle of regular polygon of 9 sides = 360°/9 = 40°

questions.question: Find the volume (in cm³) of a right circular cylinder of diameter 21 cm and height 10 cm.
questions.solution:
Radius of cylinder = r = 21/2 = 10.5 cm

Height of cylinder = h = 10 cm

Now, Volume of cylinder = πr²h

∴ Volume of given cylinder = 22/7 × 10.5 × 10.5 × 10 = 3465 cm³
